# Capability index

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name in xtremax (202 of them), each listed once at its
subpackage home and grouped by the module that defines it, with the first
sentence of its docstring. `import xtremax` re-exports the five EVT
distribution classes and every name in `xtremax.primitives`; the
point-process wrappers in `xtremax.point_processes.distributions` share
their names with the operators they wrap. Search this page before writing
a helper: if what you need is here, compose it; if it is almost here,
extend it where it lives. Regenerate with `make capabilities` after
changing a public API (`tests/test_capabilities.py` checks it is
current).

## `xtremax.distributions`

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `FrechetType2GEVD` | class | Fréchet Type II Generalized Extreme Value Distribution for NumPyro. |
| `GeneralizedExtremeValueDistribution` | class | Generalized Extreme Value Distribution (GEVD) for NumPyro. |
| `GeneralizedParetoDistribution` | class | Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) for NumPyro. |
| `GumbelType1GEVD` | class | Gumbel Type I Generalized Extreme Value Distribution for NumPyro. |
| `WeibullType3GEVD` | class | Weibull Type III Generalized Extreme Value Distribution for NumPyro. |

### Pure-JAX primitives for the Generalized Extreme Value distribution (`xtremax.primitives.gev`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `gev_cdf` | function | CDF of the Generalized Extreme Value distribution. |
| `gev_icdf` | function | Quantile function (inverse CDF) of the GEV distribution. |
| `gev_log_prob` | function | Log PDF of the Generalized Extreme Value distribution. |
| `gev_log_survival` | function | Log survival function $\log S(x) = \log(1 - F(x))$ of the GEV. |
| `gev_mean` | function | Mean of the GEV distribution (``+inf`` when $\xi \ge 1$). |
| `gev_return_level` | function | T-period return level: $z_T = F^{-1}(1 - 1/T)$. |
| `gev_survival` | function | Survival function $S(x) = 1 - F(x)$ of the GEV distribution. |

### Pure-JAX primitives for the Generalized Pareto Distribution (`xtremax.primitives.gpd`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `gpd_cdf` | function | CDF of the Generalized Pareto Distribution. |
| `gpd_icdf` | function | Quantile function (inverse CDF) of the GPD. |
| `gpd_log_prob` | function | Log PDF of the Generalized Pareto Distribution (loc = 0). |
| `gpd_log_survival` | function | Log survival $\log S(x) = -\tfrac{1}{\xi}\log(1 + \xi x/\sigma)$. |
| `gpd_mean` | function | GPD mean: $\sigma / (1 - \xi)$ for $\xi < 1$, else ``+inf``. |
| `gpd_return_level` | function | T-period return level: $Q(1 - 1/T)$. |
| `gpd_survival` | function | Survival function $S(x) = (1 + \xi x/\sigma)^{-1/\xi}$ of the GPD. |

|---|---|---|

### Pure-JAX primitives for the Homogeneous Poisson Process on ``[0, T]`` (`xtremax.point_processes.primitives.hpp`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `hpp_cumulative_intensity` | function | Compensator $\Lambda(t) = \lambda t$. |
| `hpp_exceedance_log_prob` | function | log P(N > k) over ``[start, end]``, computed via the Poisson CDF. |
| `hpp_hazard` | function | Constant hazard equal to ``rate``. |
| `hpp_intensity` | function | Constant intensity $\lambda(t) = \lambda$. |
| `hpp_inter_event_log_prob` | function | Log density of ``τ ~ Exp(λ)``: $\log \lambda - \lambda \tau$. |
| `hpp_log_prob` | function | Log-likelihood $\log L = n \log \lambda - \lambda T$. |
| `hpp_mean_residual_life` | function | Memorylessness gives $\mathbb{E}[T - s \mid T > s] = 1/\lambda$. |
| `hpp_predict_count` | function | Expected event count on ``[start, end]``: ``λ (end - start)``. |
| `hpp_return_period` | function | Time ``τ`` such that $P(\text{no event in } \tau) = 1 - p$. |
| `hpp_sample` | function | Sample ordered event times from a homogeneous Poisson process. |
| `hpp_survival` | function | $S(t\vert s) = \exp(-\lambda (t - s))$ for ``t >= s``. |

## `xtremax.simulations`

### Variable-specific extreme value generators (`xtremax.simulations.extremes`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `compute_climate_signal` | function | Combines Spatial and Temporal fields to create a mean climate signal (Mu). |
| `generate_spatial_field` | function | Generates static spatial data: Lat, Lon, Elevation, Distance to Coast. |
| `simulate_precip_extremes` | function | Simulates Precipitation Extremes: 1. |
| `simulate_temp_extremes` | function | Simulates Block Maxima Temperature via the GEV distribution. |
| `simulate_wind_extremes` | function | Simulates Extreme Wind Speeds (Gusts) using Weibull distribution. |

### Synthetic spatial-domain generators (`xtremax.simulations.spatial`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `SpatialFeatureExtractor` | class | Static methods to derive physical features from a Digital Elevation Model (DEM). |
| `augment_spatial_features` | function | Pipeline to run all extractors and merge into Dataset. |
| `compute_advanced_climate_signal` | function | Generates Tmax and Precip Mean fields using advanced physics proxies. |
| `create_iberian_domain` | function | Creates the master spatial dataset with Lat, Lon, Elevation, and Land Mask. |
| `generate_fractal_terrain` | function | Generates coherent terrain using Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm). |
| `generate_iberia_mask` | function | Procedurally generates a boolean mask approximating the Iberian Peninsula and Balearic Islands using geometrical primitives. |

### Temporal GMST trajectory generators (`xtremax.simulations.temporal`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `generate_gmst_trajectory` | function | Generates a synthetic Global Mean Surface Temperature (GMST) anomaly curve. |
| `generate_physical_gmst` | function | Simulates Global Mean Surface Temperature (GMST) using a 0-D Energy Balance Model. |
